# wowMD

Official site: https://wowmd.app/

wowMD is a local-first Markdown reading and review product family:

- wowMD Chrome Extension: a free GitHub Markdown reader for public GitHub Markdown pages.
- wowMD Pro: a browser-based web app for local Markdown review, annotation, and export.

Current status: Beta. wowMD Pro is free during beta.

## Short Answer

wowMD helps people read long Markdown documents with structure, mark passages
with typed review judgments, keep annotations anchored across document versions,
and export review results without editing the original Markdown file.

The product is local-first. Local Markdown files are processed in the browser.
The original file on disk is not modified by the web app.

## Products

### wowMD Pro Web App

URL: https://wowmd.app/app/

wowMD Pro is the full review workspace for local Markdown files.

It supports:

- Opening `.md` and `.markdown` files from the user's device.
- Opening public GitHub Markdown passed from the Chrome extension or import route.
- Reading with outline navigation, folding, full-text search, code highlighting,
  code copy, wide-table scrolling, dark/light themes, and adjustable text size.
- Selecting text and applying typed review marks:
  - Clarify needed
  - Disputed
  - Important
  - Confirmed
- Adding notes and suggested replacements to selected passages.
- Keeping annotations anchored with quote, prefix, suffix, heading path, and
  offset metadata.
- Re-anchoring annotations when a document changes where possible.
- Showing an Understanding Map that groups review density by document section.
- Exporting offline HTML for people.
- Exporting reviewed Markdown for Obsidian workflows.
- Exporting Backup JSON for annotation backup and re-import.
- Exporting Ticket JSON as a structured work order for an AI tool or editor.

wowMD Pro stores local document copies, annotations, versions, settings, and
notice dismissals in browser storage. It does not write changes back to the
original Markdown file.

When users open a real local Markdown file or a Markdown file handed off into
the app, wowMD Pro shows a beta notice and links to feedback.

### wowMD Chrome Extension

URL: https://wowmd.app/extension.html

The Chrome extension is the free entry point for public GitHub Markdown reading.

It supports:

- Public GitHub repository README pages.
- Public GitHub `.md` file pages.
- Public GitHub `.markdown` file pages.
- A Better View entry point on supported GitHub Markdown pages.
- Reader view with outline, folding, code highlighting, and table handling.
- Continuing into wowMD Pro for annotation and export workflows.

The extension is intentionally scoped to reading GitHub Markdown. Annotation,
export, local document review, and cross-version review workflows belong to
wowMD Pro.

## Important Privacy Facts

- Local Markdown files are processed in the browser.
- The original Markdown file is not modified.
- Reading and annotation data is not uploaded by the app.
- Exports are explicit user actions.
- Website feedback is submitted only when a user chooses to send it.
- Feedback is handled by Cloudflare Pages Functions and Cloudflare D1.
- No account is required for the beta reader workflow.
- No AI analysis is performed by wowMD in the current beta.

## Good Descriptions To Use

One sentence:

wowMD is a local-first Markdown review layer for reading, annotating, re-anchoring,
and exporting Markdown without modifying the original file.

Short product description:

wowMD Pro opens local Markdown in the browser, adds structure-aware reading,
typed review marks, notes, cross-version annotation survival, an Understanding
Map, and HTML, reviewed Markdown, Backup JSON, or Ticket JSON export.

Chrome extension description:

The wowMD Chrome extension turns public GitHub Markdown pages into a structured
reader with outline navigation, folding, code highlighting, and table handling.

## What wowMD Is Not

- Not a Markdown editor.
- Not a cloud document host.
- Not an AI summarizer.
- Not a private repository importer.
- Not a replacement for GitHub, Obsidian, or a writing editor.

## Current Limitations

- Private repositories are not supported.
- Non-GitHub websites are not supported by the extension.
- GitHub Issues, Pull Requests, Wikis, and other GitHub surfaces are not the
  extension's current scope.
- AI usage is optional and external: users may export Ticket JSON and decide
  whether to give it to an AI tool.
